name: Field Engineer
description: A field‑based technician who logs into the application, views assigned sites, creates and edits inspection reports, and receives follow‑up requests.

name: Site Manager
description: A manager responsible for overseeing sites; browses inspection reports, views photos, downloads PDFs and flags reports for follow‑up.

name: Administrator
description: A system administrator who creates, modifies, deactivates engineer accounts and assigns engineers to sites.

name: Backup Storage Service
description: An external cloud‑based storage or backup provider that receives nightly backups of inspection reports and photos and retains them for the required retention period.
